verdict.rationale: Railway's docs directly claim one-click deployable applications and starters for common use cases, and its MCP server can deploy templates. The evidence is only brief first-party statements. Missing for 10: details on the template catalog's breadth and how templates are customized or configured, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of one-click deployment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy one-click templates and starters for common use cases

citations.quote: One-click deployable applications and starters for common use cases.
It lets AI assistants create projects, deploy templates, manage environments, pull variables, and redeploy services.
